batch_node.name: rampart-20x-playground Actor Dimensions v0.1.0
batch_node.description: Two dimension axes as eight dimension nodes: `actor` (customer, developer, administrator) and `device` (the same three, for end-computing devices). Placement hints for the landing view; no edges, the hierarchy is carried by the dotted name (req-dcom-naming). Each node carries `tap.meta: dimension` and no `dcom` value.

node.name: actor
node.description: Which kind of person an identity is, on the playground's landing view: `customer`, `developer` or `administrator`. The three values are the nodes named `actor.<value>`. An entity carries one value or none. The layout reads it to place people; it carries no access meaning.

node.name: actor.customer
node.description: The `customer` value on the actor axis: a customer of the system.

node.name: actor.developer
node.description: The `developer` value on the actor axis: a developer who builds and ships the system.

node.name: actor.administrator
node.description: The `administrator` value on the actor axis: an infrastructure administrator who operates the system.

node.name: device
node.description: Whose end-computing device a computer is, on the playground's landing view: `customer`, `developer` or `administrator`. The three values are the nodes named `device.<value>`. An entity carries one value or none. It is a separate axis from `actor` because a person and their computer are different things. The layout reads it to place devices; it carries no access meaning.

node.name: device.customer
node.description: The `customer` value on the device axis: the end-computing device of a customer of the system.

node.name: device.developer
node.description: The `developer` value on the device axis: the end-computing device of a developer who builds and ships the system.

node.name: device.administrator
node.description: The `administrator` value on the device axis: the end-computing device of an infrastructure administrator who operates the system.
